**M12 is committed (`bfdbb9c`) — and the system just answered its founding question.** Run this yourself:

```
git for-ai ask "why was the server ref-relay tier eliminated?"
```

The real answer it gave during dogfooding, with your key and the real index:

> *"The server ref-relay tier was eliminated because it was validated to be unnecessary [1][3]. …the ledger, session traces, and change-map are stored as ordinary git refs… This was validated on 2026-07-18 by pushing all three ref namespaces to a real GitHub remote… a fresh clone and fetch reconstructed the full intent layer with zero server-side support [3]. As a result, the 'hosting' story for sync is now documentation only, not code [3]."*
> `Confidence: high (recorded intent matched by both keyword and vector retrieval)`

Every citation resolves to a real source — including the actual ledger entry from the elimination commit. And `git for-ai blame --why packages/core/src/identity/resolve.ts:31` attributes that line to the R4 redesign with its session pointer; add `--explain` for synthesized prose. The degraded cases are honest: a pre-capture line tells you plainly it's showing git metadata only. The `Confidence:` line is deterministic from retrieval signals — never the model grading itself.

**The review UI's ask panel is also live now** — rerun `git for-ai review` and the box at the bottom works, with citations linking straight to change and session pages. (Its promotion to the top of the page is your queued task #14.)

Verified before commit: all 4 packages build, 144 CLI + 30 UI + 238 core tests green, refs byte-identical after asking. This completes the walkthrough the original plan defined as "done" for steps 1–5. Remaining for the full CLI: `config`, `sync`, `doctor`, `export` — then the MCP server. Say the word.

No answers needed from you — everything remaining has an approved decision behind it, so it's all execution now. The final CLI wave is running as one sequenced agent (the pieces share files, so no parallelism this time):

1. **JSONL ledger reformat** first — your approved pre-`sync` decision, done the safe way: readers accept both formats forever, writers emit JSONL, migration happens opportunistically on the next write, and a real divergent-notes merge test proves union-merging is now conflict-free by construction.
2. **`config`** (with the Voyage consent flow), **`sync`** (explicit push/fetch over the refspecs we validated against GitHub), **`doctor`** (including the audits this project earned the hard way — inferred/orphan identity rows, dangling sessions, hooks-without-dispatcher), and **`export`** (Agent Trace format, plus a `pr-comment` markdown format for piping into `gh pr comment`).

When it lands and passes my verification, the CLI is **feature-complete against its reference**. Then two items close out the board, in order: the **MCP server** (`git for-ai mcp`, making agents native readers/writers of all this) and **task #14**, your human-first review-page redesign with the ask box promoted to the top. I'll keep verifying, committing, and pushing as each lands, and will report back with the doctor and sync dogfood results — the last two commands this system needs before it's whole.
You've hit your session limit · resets 1:50am (Pacific/Auckland)

Resumed — the agent picked up right where it stopped, with its full context intact (it had only just finished reading the specs when the limit hit, so nothing was lost). It's been told to sanity-check the working tree first, then run the whole sequence: JSONL reformat → `config` → `sync` → `doctor` → `export`, same rules as always, no committing.

Timeline expectation: this is the largest single wave yet (five items), so it'll likely run 25–40 minutes. When it reports, I'll do the usual independent verification — full build and suites, plus a personal read of the JSONL migration logic since that touches stored ledger data — then commit, push, and dogfood `doctor` and `sync` on this repo for real. After that, only the MCP server and your review-page redesign (task #14) remain on the board.
The final CLI wave is in — verifying independently before commit. First the full build+test, then a personal read of the JSONL migration logic since it touches stored ledger data:

body.text: All 533 tests green on my run. Now the high-risk read — the dual-format parser:

attributes.command:
cd C:/src/git-for-ai && git add -A && git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Complete the CLI: JSONL ledger format, config, sync, doctor, export

The final wave against CLI_REFERENCE — every command in the reference
now exists.

JSONL ledger reformat (owner-approved W3 decision): note bodies are
now one self-describing {schema, change_id, entry} canonical-JSON line
per entry (ledger-note@2), making cat_sort_uniq notes-merge
conflict-free by construction — proven by a real divergent-notes
union-merge test. Readers accept legacy @1 envelopes AND JSONL forever;
every write path (append, relink's envelope rewrite) emits JSONL only;
legacy notes migrate opportunistically on next append — reads never
write. Post-merge notes parse deterministically: byte-dedupe, mixed
change-id rejection, created_at ordering. DATA_MODEL §2.1/§2.4 and
ARCHITECTURE §12.2 updated to the @2 wire format.

config get|set: effective-value get; comment-preserving textual set
with whole-file schema validation; the Voyage consent flow per
CLI_REFERENCE (non-TTY requires --accept-consent; declining writes
nothing).

sync [--push|--fetch]: explicit-only over git-for-ai.refspec;
fetch-as-integrate with staged refs (never clobber) — intent notes via
real cat_sort_uniq merge, sessions via content-addressed union
(new core mergeSessionsFrom), change-map fast-forward or an honest
divergent-kept-local exit 2; push behind a confirm/--yes privacy gate
with per-ref --porcelain reporting; --dry-run.

doctor: 11 read-only audit rows with remediation on every non-check,
including the classes this project hit for real: dispatcher-missing
hooks, inferred/orphan identity rows, legacy-format note counts,
dangling sessions, index staleness/fingerprint. Exit 3 when unhealthy
per CLI_REFERENCE.

export: agent-trace records per the live agent-trace.dev shape
(effective entry per change, full richness under metadata.git_for_ai)
plus pr-comment markdown for gh pr comment.

62 new tests; full suite 533 across 4 packages, independently re-run.
Dogfooded every command on this repo: doctor correctly flagged the
stale index, the known inferred/orphan rows, and all 23 legacy notes;
sync round-tripped all three refs through a bare remote and a fresh
clone exported all 22 agent-trace records with zero source commits
present.

Implemented by a background Fable 5 agent (resumed across a usage
reset); reviewed (JSONL parser read personally) and committed by the
orchestrating session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin main "+refs/notes/git-for-ai/*:refs/notes/git-for-ai/*" "+refs/git-for-ai/*:refs/git-for-ai/*" 2>&1 | tail -4
